officialSources.operator: Zhanjiang Municipal Natural Resources Bureau / Zhanjiang Municipal People's Government
officialSources.observation: Official bureau portal exposes natural-resources, land, planning and real-estate-registration government information and links to the Guangdong public map service.
officialSources.scope: Local natural-resources custodian context; not a verified parcel-vector endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official real-estate-registration service entry page; it provides registration-service guidance and links, but no anonymous parcel geometry response was exposed in the retrieved HTML.
officialSources.scope: Local registration procedure/custody context; no owner or title data requested.

officialSources.observation: Current public engineering-project joint-survey supervision and results-sharing viewer. Its published config.js names a GeoScene ArcGIS MapServer for administrative-boundary context; the viewer bundle constructs standard ArcGIS envelope query URLs and requests geometry plus all fields for its map layer.
officialSources.scope: Official public viewer configuration; the exposed service address was not reachable from this research environment and was not treated as parcel coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official notice for Zhanjiang standard-map services. It describes public browsing/downloading of standard maps and required map-review attribution, not a cadastral parcel feature service.
officialSources.scope: General public cartography; no parcel polygons verified.

officialSources.observation: Official joint-survey technical material references cadastral survey results, cadastral database entry and SHP/DWG deliverables, including parcel-map production requirements.
officialSources.scope: Survey-data procedure/format evidence, not an open parcel download.

remainingUncertainty: The official local custodian and a current viewer were evidenced, but the viewer's configured backend was unreachable from this environment and its exposed layer was administrative-boundary context rather than proven parcel data. No conclusion about citywide parcel absence or completeness is made. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
